rationale: Insufficient macro data to form high-conviction view. Energy has already run +68.7% (USO 6M) and +20-37% (energy equities 6M-1Y), suggesting significant move has already occurred. Without key supply/demand fundamentals (inventories, OPEC+ policy, US production, futures curve shape, China demand), cannot assess whether current levels reflect fair value or overextension. Recent 1-day weakness across all energy vehicles (-2.1% to -8.7%) after massive run-up suggests potential consolidation. Upcoming macro events (ISM PMI Aug 3, NFP Aug 7) could provide direction but current risk/reward unclear without fundamental context. Maintaining watch for clearer supply/demand setup with better data availability.
